Container.Name: stitch-tracker
Container.Overview: Track knitting projects row by row. Add a project with notes and instructions, paste in the pattern (stripes, color changes, per-row instructions), then tap "Row done" as you go. Works offline on your phone and syncs when you're back online. Stores everything in a local SQLite file (map the /data path to persist it) — no external database needed.
Container.Description: A mobile-first knitting row counter and pattern tracker. Each project has a description, notes/instructions, a yarn color palette, and a pattern made of steps (e.g. "8 Purple", "Row 5: k2, p2 across"). Paste a pattern from your notes and it's parsed into steps and colors automatically. While knitting, a big "Row done" button advances you through the pattern, warns you on the last row before a color change, and tells you which yarn to pick up next. Installable as a PWA; edits and row taps are saved on the device first and synced to this container when it's reachable. Data lives in a single SQLite file under /data.
